title: Slide Note Texture Rotation: PPTX visual scaffolds stop repeating across lessons

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.124 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.124 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow compiler/export texture release; focused regressions plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.123 ZIP/log audit that exported 99/100 with zero P findings and Texture 92. A fresh deployed v0.15.124 audit is still required before claiming strict-clean provider output.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.123 UX audit exported and locally regraded at 99/100 with zero P findings and clean source/export/report truth.
The remaining scored loss is tied to repeated PPTX speaker-note labels and visual-kind phrasing across all 12 lesson decks.
proofCommands: rg -n "instructor visual note|accessibility note|learning-thread timeline|misconception vote-and-reveal" docs/V0.15.124_SLIDE_NOTE_TEXTURE_ROTATION_ROADMAP.md src/lib/releaseManifest.js

claims.summary: Slide visual descriptions and alt text rotate by lesson while preserving visual kind, evidence use, artifact connection, and accessibility purpose.
PPTX speaker notes rotate clean visual/accessibility labels deterministically while keeping visual guidance off student-facing slides.
PPTX regressions prove label variation without reintroducing raw scaffold strings such as SUGGESTED VISUAL, ALT TEXT, Visual guidance, or Accessibility description.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.124 ZIP/log audit must prove real UX provider output no longer repeats slide-deck visual/accessibility note shingles across all 12 lessons.
Fresh deployed output must prove Texture reaches 100/100 or identify the next concrete repeated shingle.
Every exported surface must agree: UI, ZIP, manifest, quality report, source report, digest logs, DOCX/PPTX files, and local regrade.
